title: Should we deprecate the v1 endpoint?

thread.speaker: ana
thread.text: Should we deprecate the v1 endpoint? It has been superseded for two releases now.

thread.speaker: ben
thread.text: Yes, but we need a migration window. Three months minimum.

thread.speaker: cy
thread.text: Three months is far too aggressive for our enterprise customers.

thread.speaker: ben
thread.text: They have had two years of warning. That is not aggressive, that is generous.

thread.speaker: dee
thread.text: Counterpoint: our own SDK still calls v1 internally.

thread.speaker: ana
thread.text: That is a good catch. Let me file a ticket to fix the SDK first.

thread.speaker: eve
thread.text: The auth integration test fails about one run in five.

thread.speaker: fay
thread.text: Probably the shared fixture. It does not reset the token cache.

thread.speaker: eve
thread.text: That would explain the ordering dependence. Nice.
